name.value: Wee Geordie's Cold Beer & Wine Store

description.value: Wee Geordies is a long-standing Kitimat neighbourhood pub and sports bar that has been serving the community for over 40 years, featuring live music on weekends, open mic nights, pool, darts, and multiple big screens for sports. Directly adjacent is the Wee Geordies Cold Beer & Wine Store, offering a wide selection of domestic and craft beers, wines, and spirits with a drive-up entrance for convenience. Together they form a one-stop social hub for anyone stopping in Kitimat on the North Coast.

raw_osm.name: Wee Geordie's Cold Beer & Wine Store

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at weegeordies.com is fully accessible and provides strong evidence: the business is a combined neighbourhood pub and adjacent Cold Beer & Wine Store at 178 Nechako Centre, Kitimat BC, operating 7 days a week. The OSM name focuses on the store portion while the website's primary brand is 'WEE GEORDIES PUB'; both phone numbers and the address come exclusively from the website as OSM fields were empty. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM name 'Wee Geordie's Cold Beer & Wine Store' reflects only the store portion; the website's primary brand is 'WEE GEORDIES PUB' and the two operations (pub and beer/wine store) are adjacent but distinct. The OSM record may be conflating or mis-labelling the combined business.
OSM address field is empty; address sourced entirely from website.
OSM phone field is empty; pub phone (250-632-5637) and store phone (250-632-4277) sourced from website only.
OSM tags the record as amenity=pub, which is accurate for the pub side but not the cold beer & wine store side.
